 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1.

The petitioner (husband) seeks prearrest bail in First Information Report No.763/2019 dated 04102019 under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code (IPC) and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, registered at Police Station  Danapur, Patna.

2. Ad interim protection was granted to the petitioner on 01042022 and thereafter the matter was referred to the Supreme Court Mediation Centre to explore the possibility of an amicable settlement of matrimonial disputes between the parties.

sentences.text: 4. Both the parties are making the allegations against each other, alleging solemnization of second marriage.
5. It is not in dispute that investigation is complete and chargesheet has already been filed.

6. In such circumstances, we deem it appropriate to make the interim order dated 01042022 absolute, subject to the following conditions:
(i) The Investigation Officer is directed to further investigate the allegations made by the Respondent No.2  wife alleging performance of second marriage by the petitioner and submit a supplementary report in accordance with law.
(ii) the petitioner shall appear before the Trial Court on each and every date of hearing, unless exempted, failing which it shall be taken as misuse of concession of bail.
7. Before parting with this matter, we make it clear that we have not expressed any views on the merits of the case.

8. The Special Leave Petition is disposed of in aboveterms.
 (VISHAL ANAND) (PREETHI T.C.)
ASTT.
